limitations: Version2 meter support is a SaaS-owned finite format for a verified SKU-wide maximum, not a claim that the current upstream publishes this format or a maximum.
The current18 legacy model declarations have no complete authoritative mode/condition contract; readable catalogues and non-opaque top-level fields alone do not certify completeness.
Pixel size aliases have no verified width/height map and receipt contract; no dimensions are inferred from similarly named supplier APIs.
Raw native passthrough Token execution is still explicitly gated separately; this batch covers shared video model/application preparation and reservation.
No uniform per-tool UI acceptance was started; frontend tests are regression checks only.
